issues.description: The problem statement explicitly asks for the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) to be implemented as public for testing, but both the template and the solution declare this method as private. This visibility mismatch could prevent tests or students from calling the helper method as expected and creates confusion about the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method public in the Farm class signature: public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) { ... }. Update both the template and solution Farm.java to declare the method as public and include the Animal parameter so it matches the specification and test expectations.
